pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: features/budget/BudgetMirrorPage.tsx:479 The table bar works out the peer verdict ('worse than median' → bg-signal) inline instead of calling compareToPeer, so it skips the MIN_PEERS sample guard. That guard was added on 2026-09-08 for exactly this red-on-no-sample case, so a town in a thin peer group is painted signal red here while the MetricDuo above calls the same comparison incomparable: one decision lives in two places that already disagree.

techniques.evidence: features/budget/BudgetMirrorPage.tsx:479 The peer better/worse rule is duplicated with one variation (no sample guard), so the two copies must change together but do not.

features/budget/peerGroups.ts:99 The guard that makes compareToPeer honest depends on an optional parameter. A caller that omits it silently gets a verdict on fewer than MIN_PEERS peers, so the invariant sits in the informal interface rather than inside the module (its own doc admits peerGroupFor does not enforce it).
features/budget/supplierTrail.ts:166 The supplier-join derivation takes time as a parameter and reads no clock. Its only I/O driver is the generator tool (getStore/writeFileSync).
features/budget/supplierTrail.ts:108 The join rule runs over ContractNodeLike/SuppliesEdgeLike shapes in the module's own vocabulary, and the generator and the tests feed it identically.

features/budget/supplierTrail.ts:223 The derive pass builds rows and stats together in one explicit loop (several outputs, so sequential is correct), while single-output peer selection uses a filter pipeline (peerGroups.ts:71).
features/budget/getSupplierTies.ts:24 async/cache exists only in the server-only tie loader. supplierTrail, peerGroups and mirrorData are synchronous pure functions.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: features/admin/getAdminData.ts:522 The admin tie tally rewrites the review console's drop and classification rule instead of sharing it, and the copies already disagree. The console drops a linked_to edge when the company OR the pspId is unresolved (getVerificationData.ts:102), but admin drops only on a missing company, so /admin can count ties the queue it claims to mirror never shows.

techniques.evidence: features/admin/getAdminData.ts:522 One decision (which ties the review queue holds) is hand-copied into a second module. The dated comments show it has already drifted and been patched once (reviewStateOf, 2026-09-07).
features/admin/getAdminData.ts:545 An untrusted store prop is cast to a literal union and fed to reviewTier, with no check, no marking and no stated invariant.
features/admin/loops/loopState.ts:157 deriveLoopState takes now as a value. getLoopState/driveLog are the thin fs/store shell over the pure loopState/driveState.
features/admin/loops/getLoopState.ts:65 async appears only in the loader. The loop-state and drive-chain derivations are synchronous.
features/admin/getAdminData.ts:536 The tally fills several counters and a tier array in one pass, which is the multi-output case where an explicit loop is the right form.
